$comment: Compatibility sweep round 24 list (compiled by Android compat round 27): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of each of next30-round3.json to next30-round23.json (ranks 691-720; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round24/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-10-01; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 26,860 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 24 (this round read the store's 20 listings and 653 search terms again: 4,089 ids, 29 new detail pages, the largest of them at 1,000 users, none at the bucket). Round 23's list took the rounded 200,000 bucket's next 30 by rating count down to Selectext: Copy Text from Videos at 643, so every unlisted candidate at or above the rounded 100,000 bucket (629 detail pages by the pool's stored figures: 26 above 600,000, 2 at 600,000, 2 at 500,000, 4 at 400,000, 5 at 300,000, 121 at 200,000 and 469 at 100,000) was read again on 2026-10-01, the day of this list's read; against the pool's stored figures the same sixteen user counts differ that rounds 21 to 23 recorded, and the list ranks the re-read figures: up one bucket DocsAfterDark (474 ratings - rank 701 of this list), Automation 360 and History Shortcut - Fast History Button from 100,000 to 200,000 (7 and 4 ratings - below the cut); down one bucket Link Grabber and SciSpace from 300,000 to 200,000 (261 and 144 ratings - below the cut), Extension Manager, Instant Gaming and Points Path for Google Flights from 200,000 to 100,000, and WEB.DE MailCheck, Seamless.AI, NotebookLM Tools for Gemini Notebook, Aircall Dialer, Music Mode for YouTube, Designer Tools, Meet Extension and BattleTabs from 100,000 to 70,000-90,000 (below the bucket) - and the same 27 detail pages published no user count on two reads (at the bucket Gale In Context: Opposing Viewpoints and Education Pro Browser Extension MV3 at 300,000, and NetSupport School Student, IntoWords Cloud, Assessment Lock (Vretta), Sophos Chrome Security, Single Sign-on Assistant and SAP Enable Now at 200,000 - organisation-managed items whose rating counts, 112 and fewer, fall below the cut in any case; classroom.cloud Student, Bark for Chrome Watchdog, Stop Motion Animator and the store's own Chrome Web Store item at 100,000; the other 15 organisation-managed items, Chrome Apps or themes above the bucket), so their stored figures stand, as round 23 ruled for such pages. The buckets at and above 300,000 hold no unlisted rankable item (the themes, Chrome Apps and organisation-managed items named below); ranks 691-720 are the rounded 200,000 bucket's next 30 items by rating count - iGuge (635), Add to MyRegistry.com Button (630), META SEO inspector (628), WA Sender - Bulk Messages & Automation (627), AiPrice(AliPrice) Sourcing Tool (620), Table Capture (605), Allow Copy - Select & Enable Right Click (561), Magic Eden Wallet (560), Email Finder by Skrapp.io (549), ScreenPal - Screen Recorder & Video Editor (498), DocsAfterDark (474), Simple Translate (473), RoSeal - Augmented Roblox Experience (471), Mirror Mode for Google Meet (457), Ad Block Genius - stop invasive ads (453), Bardeen: Automate Browser Apps with AI (451), Save Page WE (450), Adaware AdBlock (414), EverBee - Find Best Selling Products on Etsy (399), PDF Viewer (396), Auto Tab Discard (suspend) (389), ClickUp: Tasks, Screenshots, Email, Time (387), Twitch Adblock (377), LinkedIn Extension (376), Linguist - web page translator (369), Picture in Picture - PiP Floating Video (369; equal rounded rating counts, so by name), GIPHY for Chrome (364), Image Downloader - Fatkun AI Batch Save (362), TTV LOL PRO (362; equal, so by name) and Discrub - Discord Message Manager (329) - and the cut falls between Discrub at 329 ratings and SecondFi (Yoroi) at 315 (AutoDraw for skribbl.io at 306, Cookie Editor at 304 and Meet Plus for Google Meet at 300 behind it). One is a wallet (Magic Eden Wallet - ranked as round 20's list ranked Bitget Wallet); ClickUp carries the identity permission (Table Capture optionally, and Table Capture and Bardeen carry Google and Microsoft OAuth endpoints in their bundles), and iGuge (a proxy service), WA Sender, AiPrice, Email Finder by Skrapp.io, ScreenPal, Bardeen, EverBee, ClickUp, LinkedIn Extension and Discrub ask for a signed-in site or their services - ranked as earlier lists ranked Grammarly and HubSpot Sales. None replaces the new-tab page, none carries chrome_settings_overrides, none is a native-messaging companion (Image Downloader - Fatkun names nativeMessaging as an optional permission). Two rows have no background at all (DocsAfterDark: one content script on Google Docs and a popup, 519 KB; GIPHY for Chrome: a popup alone with the downloads permission, 1,066 KB), four carry a MAIN-world content script (RoSeal on roblox.com, Image Downloader - Fatkun on <all_urls>, TTV LOL PRO on twitch.tv, Discrub on discord.com), two open a side panel (META SEO inspector, Image Downloader - Fatkun), two carry the proxy and webRequestAuthProvider permissions (iGuge, TTV LOL PRO), ScreenPal tabCapture, iGuge management, Bardeen bookmarks, history and tts, seven carry declarativeNetRequest (AiPrice, RoSeal, Ad Block Genius, Adaware AdBlock, Twitch Adblock, Image Downloader - Fatkun, TTV LOL PRO - Adaware AdBlock with 43 static rulesets), Table Capture names userScripts as an optional permission, and iGuge, Magic Eden Wallet, RoSeal, Save Page WE, Adaware AdBlock and TTV LOL PRO name a minimum Chrome version (88 to 111). The rows carry the manifests' names, which match the store's listings for 29 of the 30; AiPrice(AliPrice)'s manifest names it in its default locale, zh_CN, "AiPrice(AliPrice)跨境卖家辅助工具", where the store's English listing and the manifest's en locale read "AiPrice(AliPrice) Sourcing Tool" (as round 16's list carried Connecteur Antidote's default-locale name). Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark, Dark Theme for Google Chrome, Sea Foam), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom, Postman), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (the list of round 21's comment - ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Endpoint Verification, Mobility Print, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, Pix Companion, Snow Web Application Metering, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, LanSchool Web Helper, iboss Cloud Connector, RapidIdentity, Browser Security Plus, Browser Redirection Extension, ActivID CMS extension, Britannica School Insights, Idira Identity Browser Extension, Citrix Web Extension, Securly for Chromebooks, Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher, Omnissa Horizon URL Content Redirection Helper, CXone Agent WebRTC Extension, iboss Classroom Management for Students, Chrome Reporting Extension, JumpCloud Go, Education Pro Browser Extension MV3, Gale In Context: Opposing Viewpoints) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
